enriched_activities.desc: Sleeps in bed. Breathes steadily. Turns onto left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Turns onto back. Extends legs. Turns onto right side. Curls up. Stretches arms. Remains motionless. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Removes clothes. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body with soap. Shampoos hair. Rinses body and hair. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Dries body with towel. Turns off water heater. Turns off light.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk and eggs. Closes refrigerator. Takes out bowl and pan. Cracks eggs into bowl. Whisks eggs. Turns on stove. Pours eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Toasts bread. Places eggs and toast on plate. Pours milk into glass. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk. Clears plate. Washes dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing emails and planning the day on the Computer, checking the Phone; no commute today because of the public transport strike, so working from home
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Turns on computer. Opens email application. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Plans day. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Makes phone call. Writes notes. Closes laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on community program coordination tasks on the Computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens computer. Opens program coordination software. Types on keyboard. Clicks mouse. Reads documents. Edits schedules. Sends emails. Attends virtual meeting. Takes notes. Makes phone calls. Updates spreadsheets. Reviews partner information. Prepares reports. Saves files. Closes programs.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread, lettuce, ham. Closes refrigerator. Takes out plate and knife. Spreads mayonnaise on bread. Places ham and lettuce on bread. Closes sandwich. Cuts sandwich in half. Places sandwich on plate. Pours water into glass. Sits at table. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Clears plate. Washes dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Settles on a show. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work on program schedules and partner coordination on the Computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Opens scheduling software. Updates program schedules. Emails partners. Calls partners. Takes notes. Reviews feedback. Adjusts schedules. Prepares meeting agenda. Sends meeting invites. Saves changes. Closes laptop.
Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Washes face. Dries face. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Applies deodorant. Combs hair. Turns off tap. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Watches TV. Changes channel. Adjusts volume. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Stands up.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and chicken. Closes refrigerator. Takes out cutting board and knife. Chops vegetables. Cuts chicken. Turns on stove. Pours oil into pan. Adds chicken to pan. Cooks chicken. Adds vegetables. Stirs ingredients. Adds spices. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Clears plate. Washes dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and browsing on the Phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Browses social media. Reads news. Watches TV. Checks messages. Replies to messages. Watches TV. Changes channel. Puts down phone. Watches TV. Turns off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Clears dishes from table. Scrapes food into trash. Opens dishwasher. Loads dishes into dishwasher. Adds detergent. Closes dishwasher. Turns on dishwasher. Wipes table. Turns off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time watching TV and chatting on the Phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Dials number. Talks on phone. Listens. Watches TV. Continues talking. Hangs up. Watches TV. Changes channel. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening routine: brushing teeth and washing face
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face. Turns off tap. Turns off light.

Walks to bedroom. Turns off light. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Breathes steadily. Turns onto left side. Adjusts pillow. Turns onto back. Extends legs. Turns onto right side. Curls up. Remains motionless. Continues sleeping.
